messages:
Ravi Patel: Dropping a compact mock for the alert preview pane. Goal: let users see how an alert travels through routes, suppression windows, and fallbacks in one glance. GIF in drive.
Sofia Chen: Looks promising. Can the preview show both timeline and a condensed textual log? Some folks prefer text for audits.
Ravi Patel: Yes — small toggle: Timeline / Log. Log shows entries like:
- 00:00 route matched
- 00:30 suppressed (maintenance window)
- 01:00 fallback to SMS
Markus Voss: Accessibility: timeline needs aria-hidden=false and each event should be focusable with a description readout (time, action, channel, outcome).
Lina Ortiz: Copy nits: change "suppressed" to "notifications paused" in UI; keep "suppressed" in audit logs for technical clarity.
a11y-bot: Also include status text, not color-only. Use icons + text and ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for critical states.
Sofia Chen: On suppression preview, can we surface why an alert bypasses suppression? e.g., "Critical alerts bypass during maintenance if route override is enabled." Small badge in the preview would help.
Ravi Patel: Good idea. I'll add a tiny rule-breach badge that expands to show the matching rule.
Markus Voss: Interaction question: when users edit a suppression window inline, do we lock the preview or live-update it? Live-update is cooler but risky if editing partial data.
Lina Ortiz: Suggest live-update with a confirm/save step and a faint outline indicating unsaved changes. Also show a small diff summary "This edit will change suppression time by 2h for 5 routes."
Sofia Chen: We need keyboard gestures for the timeline scrubber: arrow keys to move event focus, Home/End jump to start/end, and PageUp/PageDown to jump by day. Announce position with aria-live.
a11y-bot: For the diff summary, ensure its announced to screen readers when it appears. Use polite aria-live.
Ravi Patel: UX: what label do we use for the row selector? Current "Notification channels" is wordy. Options: "Escalation targets", "Notify order", "Channel order". Thoughts?
Lina Ortiz: "Escalation targets" is clear for on-call folks; "Notify order" is simpler. Maybe use "Escalation targets" in advanced settings, "Notify order" in inline editor.
Markus Voss: Also add a small cost indicator next to channels (SMS $) so teams consider impact. Tooltip should explain assumptions.
Sofia Chen: For international teams, show local times in the preview and add a banner: "Preview shown in UTC-7 (team timezone)." Allow toggle to view in route owners local time.
a11y-bot: Final accessibility checklist reminder: focus order, readable labels, keyboard reorder for lists (move up/down buttons), aria-describedby for microcopy, and color+icon redundancy.
design-bot: Critique tomorrow 9:30am PT. Please add final mocks to Drive by EOD.
Ravi Patel: Thanks all 44d I'll iterate: add log view, unsaved diff outline, bypass badge, cost chips, and timezone banner. Uploading: https://drive.redwood/design/preview-pane-iter2
